title.narrative: Environment and Wastewater Georgia: Programmatic Trust Fund with World Bank
Miljö och Avloppsvatten Georgien: Fond med Världsbanken

description.narrative: A programmatic trust fund between Sida and the WB for implementation of the Sustainable Wastewater Management Projectm (SWMP) in Georgia. The overall development objective for the SWMP is to promote sustainable wastewater management in Georgia and pilot the construction of two wastewater treatment plants. These plants will be constructed in the cites of Telavi and Tskaltubo.

En programmatisk fond mellan Sida och Världsbanken för genomförande av "the Sustainable Wastewater Management Project". Det övergripande målet för SWMP är att främja uthållig hantering av avloppsvatten i Georgien samt att bygga två moderna avloppsreningsverk i städer där sådana hittills saknats. Dessa reningsverk kommer att byggas i städerna Telavi och Tskaltubo.

* Construction works at the Telavi and Tskaltubo waste water treatment plants (wwtp) are delayed and the target to complete the plants by November 2018 was not met. A revised date for completion has now been set for July 2019. * The French construction company SADE has realized that a termination of the Telavi and Tskaltubo contracts could pose a great reputational risk. Therefore, all necessary resources to complete these projects on time have now been allocated by SADE. * The United Water Supply Company of Georgia (UWSC) is delayed in its preparations for taking over the two plants. Operational personnel have not yet been appointed and sewage connections are not ready. * Preliminary date for an official inauguration of the Telavi and Tskaltubo plants has been set for September 2019.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
